translations.idiomatic: Boqi followed his father's official career from youth, traveled to the capital, entered the Imperial University as a senior dormitory student, and accumulated credits to the highest grade.

sentences.zh: 去，以蔭授將仕郎、南海縣主簿，三轉為翰林修撰。

translations.literal: He left, and by inherited privilege was appointed Gentleman for Progress and chief clerk of Nanhai county; after three promotions he became Hanlin reviser.
translations.idiomatic: He left the university and, by inherited privilege, was appointed Gentleman for Progress and chief clerk of Nanhai county. After three promotions he became Hanlin reviser.

sentences.zh: 至正元年，改奎章閣為宣文閣、藝文監為崇文監，伯琦為宣文閣授經郎，教戚里大臣子弟，每進講，輒稱旨，且日被顧問。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhizheng the Kuizhang Pavilion was changed to the Xuanwen Pavilion and the Directorate of Literary Arts to the Directorate of Esteeming Literature; Boqi was lecturer of the Xuanwen Pavilion, teaching sons of imperial relatives and great ministers; whenever he lectured it accorded with the emperor's intent, and daily he was consulted.
translations.idiomatic: In 1341 the Kuizhang Pavilion was renamed the Xuanwen Pavilion and the Directorate of Literary Arts the Directorate of Esteeming Literature. Boqi was appointed lecturer of the Xuanwen Pavilion, teaching sons of imperial relatives and great ministers. His lectures always pleased the emperor, and he was consulted daily.

sentences.zh: 帝以伯琦工書法，命篆「宣文閣寶」，仍題扁宣文閣；

translations.literal: The emperor, because Boqi was skilled in calligraphy, ordered him to seal-cut the "Xuanwen Pavilion Treasure" and also to inscribe the plaque of the Xuanwen Pavilion;
translations.idiomatic: Because Boqi was skilled in calligraphy, the emperor ordered him to cut the seal "Treasure of the Xuanwen Pavilion" and to inscribe the pavilion's name plaque;

sentences.zh: 及摹王羲之所書蘭亭序、智永所書千文，刻石閣中。

translations.literal: and to copy Wang Xizhi's Preface to the Orchid Pavilion and Zhiyong's Thousand-Character Classic, carving them in stone within the pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: and to copy Wang Xizhi's Preface to the Orchid Pavilion and Zhiyong's Thousand-Character Classic for carving in stone within the pavilion.

sentences.zh: 自是累轉官，皆宣文、崇文之間，而眷遇益隆矣。

translations.literal: From this he was repeatedly transferred in office, all between Xuanwen and Chongwen, and imperial favor grew ever more exalted.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter his promotions kept him within the Xuanwen and Chongwen establishments, and imperial favor toward him grew ever greater.

sentences.zh: 帝嘗呼其字伯溫而不名。

translations.literal: The emperor would sometimes call him by his style Bowen rather than by name.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor would sometimes address him by his courtesy name Bowen rather than by his personal name.

sentences.zh: 會御史奏風憲宜用近臣，特命僉廣東廉訪司事。

translations.literal: When censors memorialized that censorial oversight should employ close ministers, he was specially ordered as commissioner of the Guangdong Surveillance Commission.
translations.idiomatic: When censors memorialized that censorial oversight should employ close ministers of the court, he was specially appointed commissioner of the Guangdong Surveillance Commission.

sentences.zh: 八年，召入為翰林待制，預修后妃、功臣列傳，累陞直學士。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was summoned as Hanlin attendant, participated in compiling the biographies of empresses and meritorious ministers, and was repeatedly promoted to direct academician.
translations.idiomatic: In 1348 he was recalled as Hanlin attendant, helped compile the biographies of empresses and meritorious ministers, and was promoted to direct academician.

sentences.zh: 十二年，有旨令南士皆得居省臺。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year an edict ordered that southern scholars all might hold Secretariat and Censorate posts.
translations.idiomatic: In 1352 an edict declared that southern scholars might again hold Secretariat and Censorate posts.

sentences.zh: 除伯琦兵部侍郎，遂與貢師泰同擢監察御史。

translations.literal: Boqi was appointed vice director of the Ministry of War, and thus together with Gong Shitai was promoted to investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: Boqi was appointed vice director of the Ministry of War, and he and Gong Shitai were together promoted to investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 兩人皆南士之望，一時榮之。

translations.literal: Both men were the hope of southern scholars, and for a time it was glorious.
translations.idiomatic: Both were leading figures among southern scholars, and for a time their appointment was celebrated as a great honor.

sentences.zh: 時御史大夫也先帖木兒以大軍南討，而失律喪師，陝西行臺監察御史劉希曾等十人共劾奏之。

translations.literal: At that time Censor-in-Chief Yesun Temür led a great army south in campaign but violated discipline and lost troops; Liu Xizeng and nine other investigating censors of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat jointly impeached him.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Yesun Temür was then campaigning in the south with a great army but violated discipline and lost troops. Liu Xizeng and nine other investigating censors of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat jointly impeached him.

sentences.zh: 伯琦乃劾希曾等越分干譽，希曾等皆坐左遷，補郡判官，由是不為公論所與。

translations.literal: Boqi then impeached Xizeng and the others for overstepping their bounds to seek reputation; Xizeng and the others were all punished with demotion and appointed assistant prefects of circuits; thereby he was not supported by public opinion.
translations.idiomatic: Boqi then impeached Xizeng and the others for overstepping their authority to seek reputation. They were all demoted and appointed assistant prefects of various circuits. From this he lost the support of public opinion.

sentences.zh: 十三年，遷崇文太監，兼經筵官，代祀天妃。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was transferred to director of the Directorate of Esteeming Literature, concurrently Classics Lecture official, and performed sacrifice to the Queen of Heaven as substitute.
translations.idiomatic: In 1353 he was transferred to director of the Directorate of Esteeming Literature, concurrently serving at the Classics Lecture, and performed sacrifice to the Queen of Heaven as the emperor's delegate.

sentences.zh: 丁內艱。

translations.literal: He mourned his mother.
translations.idiomatic: He went into mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 十四年，起復為江東肅政廉訪使。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was recalled from mourning as surveillance commissioner of Jiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In 1354 he was recalled from mourning as surveillance commissioner of Jiangdong.

sentences.zh: 長槍鎖南班陷寧國，伯琦與僚佐倉皇出見之，尋遁走至杭州除兵部尚書，未行，改浙西肅政廉訪使。

translations.literal: The Changqiang Suonan band fell on Ningguo; Boqi and his staff in panic went out to meet them, then fled; reaching Hangzhou he was appointed Minister of War but did not take up the post, and was changed to surveillance commissioner of western Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: When the Changqiang Suonan rebels seized Ningguo, Boqi and his staff went out in panic to meet them, then fled. Reaching Hangzhou he was appointed minister of war but did not take up the post and was instead appointed surveillance commissioner of western Zhe.

sentences.zh: 江南行臺監察御史余觀，糾言伯琦失陷寧國，宜正其罪。

translations.literal: Investigating censor Yu Guan of the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat impeached Boqi for losing Ningguo and held that his crime should be rectified.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censor Yu Guan of the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat impeached Boqi for the loss of Ningguo and argued that he should be punished.

sentences.zh: 十七年，江浙行省丞相達識帖睦爾承制假伯琦參知政事，招諭平江張士誠。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Dashi Timur, chancellor of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, by imperial commission provisionally appointed Boqi participant in government to summon and instruct Zhang Shicheng of Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1357 Dashi Timur, chancellor of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, provisionally appointed Boqi participant in government to negotiate with Zhang Shicheng of Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 士誠既降，江南行臺監察御史亦辯釋伯琦罪，除同知太常禮儀院事，士誠留之，未行，拜資政大夫、江浙行省左丞。

translations.literal: After Shicheng submitted, investigating censors of the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat also explained and cleared Boqi's guilt; he was appointed associate director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual, but Shicheng detained him and he did not depart; he was appointed Grand Master of Governance and left vice grand councillor of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhang Shicheng submitted, investigating censors of the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat also cleared Boqi of blame. He was appointed associate director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual, but Zhang Shicheng detained him and he could not leave. He was then appointed Grand Master of Governance and left vice grand councillor of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 於是留平江者十餘年。

translations.literal: Thereupon he remained at Pingjiang for more than ten years.
translations.idiomatic: He remained at Pingjiang for more than ten years.

sentences.zh: 士誠既滅，伯琦乃得歸鄱陽，尋卒。

translations.literal: After Shicheng was destroyed, Boqi was able to return to Poyang and soon died.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhang Shicheng was destroyed, Boqi was able to return to Poyang, where he soon died.

sentences.zh: 伯琦儀觀溫雅，粹然如玉，雖遭時多艱，而善於自保。

translations.literal: Boqi's bearing was warm and elegant, pure as jade; though he encountered many hardships of the age, he was skilled at preserving himself.
translations.idiomatic: Boqi's bearing was warm and elegant, pure as jade. Though he lived through many hardships of the age, he was skilled at preserving himself.

sentences.zh: 博學工文章，而尤以篆、隸、真、草擅名當時。

translations.literal: Broadly learned and skilled in literary composition, he was especially renowned in his time for seal, clerical, regular, and cursive scripts.
translations.idiomatic: Broadly learned and skilled in literary composition, he was especially renowned in his time for seal, clerical, regular, and cursive scripts.

sentences.zh: 嘗著六書正訛、說文字原二書，又有詩文稿若干卷。

translations.literal: He once authored two books, Corrections in the Six Scripts and Origins of the Explanation of Characters, and also had poetry and prose drafts in several juan.
translations.idiomatic: He authored two books, Corrections in the Six Scripts and Origins of the Explanation of Characters, and left poetry and prose drafts in several juan.

sentences.zh: 吳當字伯尚，澄之孫也。

translations.literal: Wu Dang, style name Boshang, was the grandson of Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dang, whose courtesy name was Boshang, was the grandson of Wu Cheng.

sentences.zh: 當幼承祖訓，以穎悟篤實稱。

translations.literal: Dang in youth received his grandfather's instruction and was known for keen intelligence and solid integrity.
translations.idiomatic: From childhood he received his grandfather's instruction and was known for keen intelligence and solid integrity.

sentences.zh: 長精通經史百家言，侍其祖至京，補國子生。

translations.literal: When grown he thoroughly mastered the Classics, histories, and the teachings of the hundred schools; attending his grandfather to the capital, he was enrolled as a student of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: When grown he mastered the Classics, histories, and the teachings of the hundred schools. Accompanying his grandfather to the capital, he was enrolled as a student at the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 久之，澄既捐館，四方學子從澄遊者，悉就當卒業焉。

translations.literal: After a long while, when Cheng had died, scholars from all directions who had studied with Cheng all came to Dang to complete their training.
translations.idiomatic: After Wu Cheng died, scholars from all directions who had studied under him came to Dang to complete their training.

sentences.zh: 至正五年，以父文蔭，授萬億四庫照磨，未上，用薦者改國子助教。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhizheng, by his father Wen's inherited privilege he was appointed reviser of the Treasury of the Ten Thousand Myriads, but did not take up the post; through a recommender he was changed to assistant instructor of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: In 1345, through his father Wen's inherited privilege, he was appointed reviser of the Treasury of the Ten Thousand Myriads but did not take up the post. On recommendation he was appointed assistant instructor at the Imperial University instead.

sentences.zh: 勤講解，嚴肄習，諸生皆樂從之。

translations.literal: He diligently lectured and strictly supervised practice; all the students gladly followed him.
translations.idiomatic: He lectured diligently and supervised practice strictly, and the students gladly followed him.

sentences.zh: 會詔修遼、金、宋三史，當預編纂。

translations.literal: When an edict ordered compilation of the histories of Liao, Jin, and Song, Dang participated in the compilation.
translations.idiomatic: When an edict ordered the compilation of the histories of Liao, Jin, and Song, he participated in the work.

sentences.zh: 書成，除翰林修撰。

translations.literal: When the book was completed, he was appointed Hanlin reviser.
translations.idiomatic: When the histories were completed he was appointed Hanlin reviser.

sentences.zh: 七年，遷國子博士。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to erudite of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: In 1347 he was transferred to erudite of the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 明年，陞監丞。

translations.literal: The next year he was promoted to vice chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was promoted to vice chancellor of the university.

sentences.zh: 十年，陞司業。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to vice chancellor of instruction.
translations.idiomatic: In 1350 he was promoted to vice chancellor of instruction.

sentences.zh: 明年，遷翰林待制。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to Hanlin attendant.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was transferred to Hanlin attendant.

sentences.zh: 又明年，改禮部員外郎。

translations.literal: Again the next year he was changed to vice director of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: The year after that he was appointed vice director of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 十三年，擢監察御史，尋復為國子司業。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was promoted to investigating censor, and soon was again made vice chancellor of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: In 1353 he was promoted to investigating censor, and soon afterward was again appointed vice chancellor of the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 明年，遷禮部郎中。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to director of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was transferred to director of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 又明年，除翰林直學士。

translations.literal: Again the next year he was appointed direct academician of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: The year after that he was appointed direct academician of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 時江南兵起且五年，大臣有薦當世居江西，習知江西民俗，且其才可任政事者，詔特授江西肅政廉訪使，偕江西行省參政火你赤、兵部尚書黃昭，招捕江西諸郡，便宜行事。

translations.literal: At that time warfare in the Jiangnan had arisen for nearly five years; a great minister recommended that Dang, having lived in Jiangxi, was familiar with Jiangxi customs and folkways and his talent could undertake government affairs; an edict specially appointed him surveillance commissioner of Jiangxi, together with Participant in Government Huonijichi of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat and Minister of War Huang Zhao, to summon and capture the various prefectures of Jiangxi with discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: Warfare in the Jiangnan had then been raging for nearly five years. A senior minister recommended Dang, who had long lived in Jiangxi and knew its customs, as a man whose talent suited government affairs. An edict specially appointed him surveillance commissioner of Jiangxi, together with Participant in Government Huonijichi of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat and Minister of War Huang Zhao, to pacify the prefectures of Jiangxi with discretionary authority.

sentences.zh: 當以朝廷兵力不給，既受命至江南，即召募民兵，由浙入閩。

translations.literal: Dang, considering that the court's military strength was insufficient, once he received orders and reached the Jiangnan, immediately recruited militia and entered Fujian from Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: Judging that the court's military strength was insufficient, once he received his commission and reached the Jiangnan he immediately recruited militia and advanced from Zhe into Fujian.

sentences.zh: 至江西境建昌界，招安新城孫塔，擒殄李三。

translations.literal: Reaching the border of Jianchang in Jiangxi territory, he won over Sun Ta of Xincheng by persuasion and captured and exterminated Li San.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching the Jianchang border in Jiangxi, he won over Sun Ta of Xincheng by persuasion and captured and destroyed Li San.

sentences.zh: 道路既通，乃進攻南豐，渠凶鄭天瑞遁，鄭原自刎死。

translations.literal: Once the roads were open, he then advanced to attack Nanfeng; the ringleader Zheng Tianrui fled, and Zheng Yuan killed himself by cutting his throat.
translations.idiomatic: Once the roads were secure he advanced on Nanfeng. The ringleader Zheng Tianrui fled, and Zheng Yuan committed suicide by cutting his throat.

sentences.zh: 十六年，調檢校章迪率本部兵，與黃昭夾攻撫州，勦殺首寇胡志學，進兵復崇仁、宜黃。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he ordered revising official Zhang Di to lead his own troops, and together with Huang Zhao attacked Fuzhou from both sides, exterminated the chief bandit Hu Zhixue, and advanced the army to recover Chongren and Yihuang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1356 he ordered revising official Zhang Di to lead his troops in a pincer attack on Fuzhou with Huang Zhao, exterminated the chief rebel Hu Zhixue, and advanced to recover Chongren and Yihuang.

sentences.zh: 於是建、撫兩郡悉定。

translations.literal: Thereupon the two prefectures of Jian and Fu were entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectures of Jianchang and Fuzhou were thereby fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 是時，參知政事朶歹緫兵撫、建，積年無功。

translations.literal: At that time Participant in Government Duodai commanded troops in Fu and Jian for many years without achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Participant in Government Duodai had then been commanding troops in Fuzhou and Jianchang for years without success.

sentences.zh: 因忌當屢捷，功在己上，又以為南人不宜緫兵，則搆為飛語，謂當與黃昭皆與寇通。

translations.literal: Because he resented Dang's repeated victories and that his merit stood above his own, and also held that southerners were not fit to command troops, he fabricated slanderous rumors, saying that Dang and Huang Zhao both communicated with the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Resenting Dang's repeated victories and his own lesser merit, and believing that southerners ought not command troops, he fabricated slanderous rumors claiming that Dang and Huang Zhao were both in league with the rebels.

sentences.zh: 有旨解二人兵柄，除當撫州路緫管，昭臨江路緫管，並供億平章火你赤軍。

translations.literal: An edict removed the two men's military authority; Dang was appointed general administrator of Fuzhou circuit, Zhao general administrator of Linjiang circuit, and both were to supply provisions for Pacification Commissioner Huonijichi's army.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped them of military command. Dang was appointed general administrator of Fuzhou circuit and Zhao of Linjiang circuit, and both were ordered to supply Pacification Commissioner Huonijichi's army.

sentences.zh: 火你赤殺當從事官范淳及章迪，將士皆憤怒不平，當諭之曰：「上命不可違也。

translations.literal: Huonijichi killed Dang's staff officers Fan Chun and Zhang Di; officers and soldiers were all angry and resentful; Dang instructed them, saying: "The sovereign's command cannot be disobeyed.
translations.idiomatic: Huonijichi killed Dang's staff officers Fan Chun and Zhang Di. The officers and soldiers were furious, but Dang told them: "The sovereign's command cannot be disobeyed."

sentences.zh: 」而火你赤又上章言：「二人者，難任牧民。

translations.literal: "Yet Huonijichi again submitted a memorial saying: "These two men are unfit to shepherd the people.
translations.idiomatic: Huonijichi then memorialized again: "These two men are unfit to govern the people."

sentences.zh: 」尋有旨當與昭皆罷緫管，除名。

translations.literal: "Soon an edict ordered that Dang and Zhao both be removed as general administrators and struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict removed Dang and Zhao from their posts as general administrators and struck their names from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 十八年，火你赤自瑞州還龍興，當、昭皆隨軍不敢去。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Huonijichi returned from Ruizhou to Longxing; Dang and Zhao both followed the army and dared not leave.
translations.idiomatic: In 1358 Huonijichi returned from Ruizhou to Longxing. Dang and Zhao both followed the army and dared not leave.

sentences.zh: 先是，當與昭平賊功狀，自廣東由海道未達京師，而朶歹、火你赤等公牘乃先至，故朝廷責當、昭，皆左遷。

translations.literal: Earlier, Dang and Zhao's reports on pacifying bandits, sent from Guangdong by sea route, had not reached the capital, while the official documents of Duodai, Huonijichi, and others arrived first; therefore the court blamed Dang and Zhao, and both were demoted.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Dang and Zhao's reports on pacifying the rebels, sent from Guangdong by sea, had not reached the capital, while the memorials of Duodai, Huonijichi, and others arrived first. The court therefore blamed Dang and Zhao and demoted them both.

sentences.zh: 及得當、昭功狀，乃始知其誣，詔拜當中奉大夫、江西行省參知政事，昭湖廣行省參知政事。

translations.literal: When Dang and Zhao's merit reports were received, the court then knew they had been slandered; an edict appointed Dang Grand Master of the Palace Attendance and participant in government of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, and Zhao participant in government of the Huguang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When Dang and Zhao's merit reports finally arrived, the court learned they had been slandered. An edict appointed Dang Grand Master of the Palace Attendance and participant in government of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, and Zhao participant in government of the Huguang Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 命未下，而陳友諒已陷江西諸郡。

translations.literal: Before the orders were issued, Chen Youliang had already fallen on the various prefectures of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Before the appointments could be issued, Chen Youliang had already seized the prefectures of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 火你赤棄城遁，當乃戴黃冠，著道士服，杜門不出，日以著書為事。

translations.literal: Huonijichi abandoned the city and fled; Dang then wore a yellow cap and donned Daoist robes, shut his door and did not go out, and daily made authorship his occupation.
translations.idiomatic: Huonijichi abandoned the city and fled. Dang then put on a yellow cap and Daoist robes, shut his door, and devoted himself daily to writing.

sentences.zh: 友諒遣人辟之，當卧床不食，以死自誓，乃舁床載之舟，送江州，拘留一年，終不為屈。

translations.literal: Youliang sent men to recruit him; Dang lay in bed and did not eat, vowing death; they then carried his bed onto a boat and sent him to Jiangzhou, detained him for a year, and in the end he was not bent.
translations.idiomatic: Youliang sent men to recruit him. Dang took to his bed and refused to eat, vowing to die rather than submit. They carried his bed onto a boat and sent him to Jiangzhou, where he was detained for a year but never yielded.

sentences.zh: 遂隱居廬陵吉水之谷坪。

translations.literal: Thereupon he went into seclusion at Guping in Jishui, Luling.
translations.idiomatic: He then went into seclusion at Guping in Jishui, Luling.

sentences.zh: 逾年，以疾卒，年六十五。

translations.literal: After more than a year he died of illness at age sixty-five.
translations.idiomatic: A little more than a year later he died of illness at the age of sixty-five.

sentences.zh: 所著書，有周禮纂言及學言稿。

translations.literal: Books he authored include Collected Sayings on the Rites of Zhou and Drafts of Learning Sayings.
translations.idiomatic: His writings include Collected Sayings on the Rites of Zhou and Drafts of Learning Sayings.
